sources.title: Cleveland-Cliffs to idle output at Canada steel plant, blames tariffs, says CBC
evidence: Citing an internal memo, CBC said the company would indefinitely idle its cold-rolled and coated operations at the Stelco plant, with operations set to begin winding down on October 9. Up to 500 employees will be affected.
US President Donald Trump signed an executive order in June 2025 applying an up to 50% tariff to certain steel and aluminum imports from Canada.
In a media release, Stelco confirmed it was idling finishing operations in Hamilton, and said it would concentrate steel production at its Nanticoke, Ontario works.

sources.title: Congo to audit major miners annually from 2027 as part of local content drive, regulator says
evidence: Democratic Republic of Congo will subject major mining companies to annual audits of subcontracting practices and compliance with local-content requirements from 2027, as authorities step up efforts to increase business for Congolese-owned firms, the head of the country's subcontracting regulator told Reuters.
A new local-content law is due to take effect on January 1, 2027.

ARSP this month ordered Glencore, Ivanhoe's Kipushi zinc mine and Chinese-controlled copper miner Sicomines to end non-compliant subcontracting arrangements, submit corrective plans and expand opportunities for Congolese-owned suppliers.

Of the $3.7 billion in subcontracting contracts declared by 167 major companies in 2025, $3.1 billion, or 83%, went to majority Congolese-owned companies, including $2.9 billion in the mining sector alone, Beleshayi said.

sources.title: OCI, TDI "한계사업" 전격 철수 결정
evidence: OCI는 9월29일 이사회에서 TDI 제조 및 판매 사업을 종료하기로 결정했으며, 12월18일부터 관련 운영을 공식적으로 중단할 계획이라고 발표했다.
TDI 사업은 2025년 매출액이 약 1179억4700만원으로 전체 연결 매출액의 약 5.87%에 해당한다.
